name: HOZO finance claim named personal templates
requiresDatabases: Existing AM Platform PostgreSQL claims authority database
Existing Rental D1 Finance Claims database
requiresEnv: Existing Finance Claims v3 bridge configuration
dependencies: AM-IMP-2026.0914.05 Claim form retirement and immutable version history

dataIsolation.guard: Templates are stored in Rental/Finance by canonical tenant and identity. AMCore contains no LINE user IDs, template rows, or financial form contents.

definitionOfDone: Each verified LINE identity can keep up to 20 named private templates per claim form
Legacy and V3 forms let the current user select, apply, update, rename, and delete their own templates
Dates, invoice numbers, receipts, OCR state and submission state are excluded
Authorization and tenant/form/source boundaries are revalidated on every read and write
Local verification and package checks pass
